name: Möbius v0.1 Personal AI OS
description: Self-hosted AI agent that builds and runs apps for you, with memory.

upstream.version: 0.1.0 (declared in frontend/package.json and the FastAPI app; upstream publishes no releases)

PORT.description: Port of the Möbius web app and API. Railway's healthcheck and the public domain use it; keep 8000 unless you also change the domain's target port.

MOBIUS_OWNER_USERNAME.description: Owner login name, generated at deploy and created before the app goes online. Random on purpose (failed logins put a cooldown on a username). Change it to rename the login on the next deploy.

MOBIUS_OWNER_PASSWORD.description: Owner password (12+ characters), generated at deploy. Changing it here resets the login on the next deploy and signs out every session; a password changed inside Möbius is kept until this changes.

MOBIUS_AGENT_SUDO.description: 1 (upstream default) gives the agent passwordless root inside the container, e.g. to install packages; 0 removes it. Takes effect on the next deploy.

DOMAIN.description: Optional. Your custom domain as a bare host name (e.g. ai.example.com), once it is attached to this service. Empty = the Railway domain.

MOBIUS_SERVICE_GATEWAY_ORIGIN.description: Optional. https:// origin of a second custom domain on this service, used only for full web services you opt in (local-services.json). Empty = off.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds the old container gets to finish replies before a redeploy stops it (upstream's value; its server drains for 10 s).
